children: Ace investor Ashish Kacholia on Monday sold nearly 1 percent of his equity stake in Xpro India, a polymer processing and manufacturing company affiliated with the Birla Group, through open-market transactions.

According to bulk deal data published by the National Stock Exchange (NSE) on October 19, Kacholia sold 2.22 lakh equity shares worth Rs 21.53 crore, representing 0.94 percent of the company's paid-up equity capital. The shares were sold at an average price of Rs 970.11 apiece.
As of September 2026, Kacholia held a 2.01 percent stake in Xpro India, equivalent to 4.71 lakh shares.
Despite the stake sale, Xpro India shares rose 1.79 percent to close at Rs 995 on Monday, snapping a five-day losing streak.

However, the stock has remained under pressure since hitting its September swing high, despite intermittent buying interest. It has declined more than 31 percent from its September 2026 high of Rs 1,408.70.
Rishi Kajaria buys additional 0.73% stake in Swaraj Suiting
High-net-worth individual (HNI) investor Rishi Kajaria has acquired an additional 1.94 lakh equity shares in Swaraj Suiting, representing 0.73 percent of the company's paid-up equity capital.
The shares were acquired for Rs 6.29 crore at an average price of Rs 323.38 apiece.
As of September 2026, Kajaria already held a 1.24 percent stake in Swaraj Suiting, equivalent to 3.26 lakh shares.
Swaraj Suiting manufactures cotton and synthetic fabrics.

title: Ashish Kacholia sells nearly 1% stake in Xpro India
